leak-scan.reason: repo is PUBLIC (gh visibility=PUBLIC, verified at migration); init defaulted public=false unchecked.

items.writer: verb:item add, verb:item park, verb:item close
items.staleness: change-coupling — an item whose evidence or requirement record pointer no longer resolves

exit.detail: to ITEMS-DONE.md on DONE or DROPPED

items.growth: bounded-by-exit — every item leaves by a recorded closure or a recorded drop, and the alarm is a kind that grew without an exit event, never a count (R22)
items.trigger: verb item add — admission is the write that CREATES a body; `item park` and `item close` move one already admitted, so they are transitions of this kind rather than its trigger

done bodies.staleness: none, declared why: a closure record is history — it accumulates, it does not go stale

exit.recording-act: a ledger decision line naming the compacted range
exit.detail: WAVE 4 — declared now so the kind has no undeclared stage, not implemented

done bodies.growth: compacted — done bodies fold on the retire lane's declared rule and git keeps the body; the archive section is history and dropping it would lose the basis of laws still in force

ledger lines.writer: verb:ledger add decision, verb:ledger add dropped, verb:ledger add rejected, verb:ledger add superseded, session
ledger lines.staleness: none, declared why: append-only decision history

exit.recording-act: compaction only — a line whose item is DONE and past the horizon folds into that body's compaction line

ledger lines.growth: unbounded-with-reason — one line per decision event, no bodies; the decision rate is the control, and the pre-migration prose sits below the archive heading held verbatim
ledger lines.trigger: verb ledger add decision — the button, and one of four: `ledger add` is a command GROUP, so the trigger names a leaf; `dropped`, `rejected` and `superseded` write this kind by the same act and are listed in the writer; `session` is the path around the button, for a fact or an open question
